sentences.ko: 어디 보자, 나 그 테스트 해봤는데 역시 난 연애보다 일이 먼저더라.
sentences.text: All right, I took the quiz and it turns out I do put career before men.

alts.text: Yeah, took that quiz and yep — career over guys, no surprise there.
I completed the quiz, and the results indicate that I prioritize my career over relationships.

sentences.note: **put career before men**는 연애보다 일을 우선한다는 뜻이에요. "put A before B" 형태로 우선순위를 말할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 음, 아마 둘이 싸웠고 그래서 걔가 술에 취했나 봐.
sentences.text: Yeah, well, I guess they had a fight and he got drunk.

alts.text: So I'm guessing they got into it and he ended up wasted.
I believe they had an argument, and as a result, he became intoxicated.

sentences.note: 확실하지 않은 일을 말할 때 문장 앞에 **I guess**를 붙이면 "아마 ~인 것 같아"라는 추측의 뉘앙스가 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 마지막으로 질문 하나만 더 받을게요, 이분이 아주 참을성 있게 기다리셨으니까요.
sentences.text: Let me take one last question because this gentleman's waited very patiently.

alts.text: One more question — this guy's been super patient, so go ahead.
I will take one final question, as this gentleman has waited quite patiently.

sentences.note: 질문을 마무리하고 싶을 때 **Let me take one last question**라고 하면 "마지막으로 질문 하나만 더 받을게요"라는 뜻이에요. 회의나 강연에서 자주 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 제가 이걸 공짜로 들어도 될까요? (빌 애크먼)

sentences.ko: 어, 걔가 카펫을 다 걷어내서 이제 소리가 다 들려.
sentences.text: Yeah, he took up the carpets and now you can hear everything.

alts.text: He ripped out the carpets, so now you can hear every little thing.
As it turns out, he removed the carpets, so every sound comes through now.

sentences.note: **took up the carpets**는 바닥에 깔려 있던 카펫을 걷어냈다는 뜻이에요. "take up"은 바닥재 등을 뜯어내거나 걷어낼 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 지금 언니(여동생)를 통화 대기시켜 놨는데, 이번 주말에 그 집 오두막 빌려서 스키 타러 가도 된대.
sentences.text: Because I have my sister on hold and she said that we could have her cabin for the weekend and go skiing.

alts.text: My sister's on hold right now, and she says we can grab her cabin this weekend and go skiing.
I currently have my sister on hold, and she has informed me that we may use her cabin this weekend to go skiing.

sentences.note: 전화 통화 중 상대를 잠깐 기다리게 할 때 **on hold**라고 해요. "have someone on hold"는 그 사람을 통화 대기시켜 놓았다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
